messages:
julia: hey team, quick onboarding Q — i'm pairing with someone tomorrow and want to use the hosted API for a short live demo. should we use my sandbox key or request a hosted key? also what's the easiest way to get a temporary bump so we don't hit 429s mid-pairing?

samir: welcome! for short pair-programming or demos use sandbox keys or a time-limited demo key. Hosted/prod keys are billing-enabled and require an org-admin to create plus a security review if you touch customer data.

julia: ok — what's the default sandbox quota/rate-limit so i can estimate traffic? and is there a dedicated flow for a 1-hr pairing session?

devex-bot: Default sandbox for new hires: typically a promo credit ($30-$50 depending on cohort) and a soft token quota (around 40k-75k tokens/month). Typical per-key rate-limit: ~15-20 reqs/sec steady, short bursts allowed up to ~60-80 reqs/sec for a few seconds. Concurrent streaming connections are often capped (ex: ~40 streams). For a one-hour pairing/session, file a request at https://go/redwood-help and choose "Sandbox/demo quota" — include start/end time, expected RPS and concurrent streams, and a token estimate. Ops or eng-sre will issue a time-limited elevated key for the window.

platform-oncall: note: if you need sustained higher quota (multi-hour or >200k tokens), we prefer using a staging org/service account instead of bumping sandbox credits. Also hosted keys with customer-data scope need security signoff; expect ~1 business day for that flow.

samir: practical tips: 1) never commit keys — use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var or Vault. 2) for demos implement a client-side semaphore to cap concurrent streams (keeps you under stream limits). 3) check response headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-Stream-Connections, Retry-After and handle 429s with exponential backoff.

curl quickcheck (sandbox):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-mini","input":"quick test"}'
```

julia: perfect, i'll open the help ticket with the window and expected concurrent streams. samir — would you be able to coordinate the staging key if we need it?

samir: can do. ping me the details after you file the ticket and i'll cc eng-sre. also i'll DM you a small checklist for demo-safe envs (no hardcoded keys, rotate after, use ephemeral results). :thumbsup:
